accounts_status_timestamps.name: accounts_status_timestamps
accounts_status_timestamps.value:
(
        ("town"."accounts"."status" = 'pending_email'
          and "town"."accounts"."account_ready_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."suspended_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("town"."accounts"."status" = 'pending_password'
          and "town"."accounts"."account_ready_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."suspended_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("town"."accounts"."status" = 'pending_passkey'
          and "town"."accounts"."account_ready_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."suspended_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("town"."accounts"."status" = 'active'
          and "town"."accounts"."account_ready_at" is not null
          and "town"."accounts"."suspended_at" is null
          and "town"."accounts"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("town"."accounts"."status" = 'suspended'
          and "town"."accounts"."account_ready_at" is not null
          and "town"."accounts"."suspended_at" is not null
          and "town"."accounts"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("town"."accounts"."status" = 'closed'
          and "town"."accounts"."account_ready_at" is not null
          and "town"."accounts"."closed_at" is not null)
      )

civic_process_transitions_supported_path.name: civic_process_transitions_supported_paths
civic_process_transitions_supported_path.value:
(
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'confirmation'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'proposals'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'confirmation_threshold_reached'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'proposals'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'deliberation'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'proposal_threshold_reached'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'deliberation'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'ballot_preparation'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'deliberation_threshold_reached'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'ballot_preparation'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'voting'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'ballot_prepared'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'voting'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'deliberation'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'quorum_not_reached'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'voting'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'mandate'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'voting_window_closed'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'mandate'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'action'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'mandate_decided'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'action'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'verification'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'action_marked_ready'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'verification'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'archived'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'verification_delivered_threshold_reached'
      ) or (
        "town"."civic_process_transitions"."from_stage" = 'verification'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."to_stage" = 'archived'
        and "town"."civic_process_transitions"."reason_key" = 'verification_not_delivered_threshold_reached'
      )

membership_entitlements_state_invariants.name: membership_entitlements_state_invariants
membership_entitlements_state_invariants.value:
(
        ("town"."membership_entitlements"."status" = 'inactive'
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."access_until" is null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" = false)
        or ("town"."membership_entitlements"."status" = 'active'
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."access_until" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" = false
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."activated_at" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."expired_at" is null)
        or ("town"."membership_entitlements"."status" = 'cancelling'
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."access_until" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" = true
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancellation_requested_at" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."expired_at" is null)
        or ("town"."membership_entitlements"."status" = 'expired'
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."access_until" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" = false
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."expired_at" is not null)
        or ("town"."membership_entitlements"."status" = 'paid_pending_binding'
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."access_until" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" = false
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."activated_at" is null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."cancellation_requested_at" is null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."expired_at" is null)
        or ("town"."membership_entitlements"."status" = 'suspended'
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."access_until" is not null
          and "town"."membership_entitlements"."expired_at" is null)
      )
